description: This Java class implements a conditional operation for comparing fields within the Apache OFBiz mini-language framework. It defines the CompareFieldCondition class, which evaluates a comparison between two fields based on specified operators and optional formatting, and executes sub-operations based on the result.

classes.name: CompareFieldCondition
classes.description: Implements a conditional comparison between two fields with support for operators, formatting, and sub-operations based on the comparison result.

classes.name: CompareFieldConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CompareFieldCondition from XML elements.

methods.name: autoCorrect
methods.description: Corrects missing 'to-field' attribute in the XML element during transition from v1 to v2.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison condition between two fields based on the specified operator and format.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes sub-operations if the condition is true, or else sub-operations if false.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from sub-operations for analysis.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string describing the comparison operation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the XML element for this condition.
